title: Battle of Chuvash Cape
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Chuvash Cape", at revision 1370437275, opens: "The Battle of Chuvash Cape led to the victory of a Russian expedition under Yermak Timofeyevich and the fall of Khanate of Sibir and the end of Khan Kuchum's power. The battle took place near Qashliq (Isker), in Siberia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2723462, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1582 Russian expedition that led to the fall of Khanate of Sibir and the end of Khan Kuchum's power". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
